$comment:
#95 (madrasah-frontend) → unified Medaris design system, v2. Every #95 token (172), component export (25 functions + controlStyle, ICON_NAMES, FILLED_ICON_NAMES), sub-type (3) and raw colour literal (8) appears exactly once. tokens.*: `to` is the default target; `byProperty` (text = color/caret-color/text-decoration-color; bg = background*; border = border*/outline*; icon = fill/stroke; ring = focus box-shadow) wins over `to`; `contexts` (array of {when, to, property?, inherits?}) win over byProperty and need a human or agent to match `when`. Every target is a bare token name or a .mds-* class; prose lives in `note`. kind: exact | role | nearest | dropped. collision: the same name exists elsewhere; inherits (on a token): its targets are pairs that wait on that open decision, so the value bridge leaves the name out; resolvesSilently: benign|drift — a missed rename of that name does NOT fail, it resolves to the unified system's value; check-port greps for exactly these names. components.*: op rename | restructure | drop | reserved; props.

= {to, values?, valueContexts?, transform?, note?}; `requires` lists props the unified component needs that #95 did not have; `set` lists props to add. review: true = decide per use. A #95 name missing from this file is a bug in this file.

pin.recipe: files = tokens/, src/, tools/, docs/ (recursive) + package.json, tsup.config.ts, tsconfig.json, project.json, DESIGN_RULES.md, GUIDE.md, PROMPTS.md, README.md, SYNC.md, minus dist/, node_modules/, MANIFEST.json (the INCLUDE rules of #95's tools/manifest.mjs); paths relative to the package, sorted by code unit; lines `path:sha256hex`; joined with \n, no trailing newline; sha256; first 12 hex

--focus-ring.delta: a colour (#1d4ed8) → canonical box-shadow composite; its value is open decision #1
--focus-ring.note: Open decision 1. --ring-focus is a whole box-shadow: write `box-shadow: var(--ring-focus)`, never `outline-color`. The invalid-field ring --ring-focus-error (#FECACA, 1.45:1) is part of the same decision; a11y-overrides.css re-points only --ring-focus. Kept out of the value bridge: #95 used the name as a colour (6.70:1 on white), and the bridged value would be a whole box-shadow at 1.26:1.

--font-ui.note: Inter is not a brand face; x-height 0.546 → 0.516 em, so equal px renders 5.5% smaller — the reason ties round up in the size table.
--font-ui.silentNote: benign for body text and controls, which converge on the canonical family (Plex Sans); a heading set in --font-ui takes .mds-h* instead (Cairo, --font-display; MDS-TYPE-01, MDS-TYPE-03)

--font-arabic.note: UI and inline Arabic → --font-arabic (IBM Plex Sans Arabic). Classical and Qur'anic text → --font-arabic-text (.mds-arabic-text); its face is SPEC-D3-06.
--font-arabic.silentNote: classical/Qur'anic text silently takes the UI Arabic face; it should be .mds-arabic-text / --font-arabic-text

--font-mono.note: #95 used the system mono stack; canonical names Plex Mono.
--font-mono.silentNote: converges on Plex Mono, the policy outcome

--font-feature-ui.note: "ss01","cv11" are Inter's open digits + single-storey a. Carried over it would switch Plex Sans' and Plex Sans Arabic's ss01 (alternate a) on every body run — measured in the GSUB tables. Canonical sets no features.

--fs-14.note: controls → 14; **#95 body copy (14) → .mds-body 16** — canonical: reading text is 16

--tracking-display.note: −0.8px at 33px = −0.024em. Canonical applies tracking only from h2 (48) up.

--tracking-eyebrow.note: Used by .mds-eyebrow and .mds-nav-section. Never on Arabic runs.

--lh-snug.note: #95 --lh-snug (1.45) is a meta-row leading; canonical --lh-snug (1.25) is a heading leading — same name, different meaning.
